instruction.text: Select the cave to learn more about the Arctic.

end.text: The Arctic is a part of the world that is so cold, it’s like winter all year long. The Arctic is a northern region, where the North Pole is. There aren’t as many plants or animals as in other parts of the world because of how cold it is.

instruction.text: What do you know about the tundra? Select one of the mountains to learn more.

end.text: The tundra is a part of the Arctic that is past the tree line. This means that it is so far north that most plants do not grow here any more, because of how cold it is.

instruction.text: What do you know about lichen? Select the fluffy white thing to learn more.

end.text: Lichen are plant-like organisms. There are many types of lichen. One of the most common kinds you might be familiar with is moss.

atoms.text: Musk oxen are large mammals who are related to mountain goats. The average adult musk ox can weigh between 200-350 kilograms. Musk oxen typically live between 12-20 years. They have large horns to fight predators and long, thick hair to protect them from the cold, difficult winters. In the spring, once the weather gets warmer, they begin to shed their winter hair. In the summer, they eat a lot in order to store fat so that they can survive the winter.

Musk oxen are herbivores. Their favourite foods are roots, grass, moss and lichen. Their main predators are wolves and humans. To protect themselves against predators, musk oxen form a large circle with their calves in the middle. The adults face outwards towards the predators with their sharp horns. There was a time, when human hunters killed many musk oxen. Today, however, there are laws that protect these impressive animals.

Musk oxen live in the tundra and like to live in herds of about 20-30 oxen. Their herds are led by female oxen. They live in Canada, Greenland, northern Russia and the high Arctic Islands. Every year in autumn, male musk oxen fight each other for the attention of female musk oxen and to have calves with them. Female musk oxen are pregnant for about 8 months and bear their calves in spring.
